title: G4MF Mesh Deformation Blend Properties
description: Blend shapes, also known as morph targets, define how a mesh can be deformed by displacing its vertex positions and other attributes. This schema contains an array of blend shapes and their activation amounts.

amounts.description: How much influence each blend shape has on the mesh. A typical value ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, where 0.0 means no influence and 1.0 means full influence, but values may go beyond this range for exaggerated or inverted effects. If defined, this array must match the number of items in `shapes`. If `amounts` is not defined, it is implicitly an array of zeroes with the same size as `shapes`.

shapes.description: An array of blend shape morph targets that define the deformations applied to the mesh. The size of this array must match the size of `amounts` if that array is defined, or the size of the shapes array defines the implicit size of `amounts`.
